_about: Music (src/audio/music.js; picks + tools in docs/systems/sound.md MUSIC). screens: which track each screen plays; a LIST = those tracks take turns (each plays its intro + loop once, then fades into the next). tracks: file in src/assets/music/<file>.mp3, loopStart = seconds where the repeating part starts (it repeats to the end of the file), written by docs/proposals/music/make-game-music.py. volume = music loudness at MUSIC 10 (the Settings bar scales it). fadeSec = crossfade between screens, turnFadeSec = crossfade when battle songs take turns.
